note: Story content for the quest system, converted from ArtDirection/Story/main-quest.md and side-quests.md (story session v1). Lines keep the bible's ids; their cues are /Game/Audio/Jam/Voice/Cues/SCue_VO_<id>. Lines the villain plays itself (MQ07_02, MQ09_*, MQ_BAND_*, MQ_LOSE_01) and cutscene lines (CSxx_nn) are not here. Build the asset with Tools/Quests/import_story.py.

quests.title: The Mirror Made Whole
quests.summary: The Tarnish is wearing Lanthorne's faces. The mirror that could stop it was cut in three, one page to each side of the city. Find the pages, make the mirror whole, and let the light through.

steps.title: Lantern Law
steps.description: Dusk bell. The Lamp Companies are marching again, and Ilse wants me on Lantern Row.

steps.title: Lantern Row
steps.description: Ilse made me cast at a lamp post like I was twelve again. She's frightened. She doesn't get frightened.

objectives.text: Find Ilse Varrow on Lantern Row
hints: Ilse sells candles on Lantern Row, the candle-and-glass market.

completeLines.speaker: ilse_varrow
completeLines.text: You're late, and you're limping. Which first?

completeLines.speaker: wren_hale
completeLines.text: Neither. I came the long way.

completeLines.speaker: ilse_varrow
completeLines.text: Mm. Show me your hands. Aim at the lamp post.

completeLines.speaker: ilse_varrow
completeLines.text: Light's the only thing it hates. Cast like you mean it.

hints: Hold the right mouse button (left trigger) to aim, then the left mouse button (right trigger) to cast.

completeLines.speaker: ilse_varrow
completeLines.text: Better. Now keep that hand ready. It's close tonight.

lines.speaker: wren_hale
lines.text: Somebody's wearing the Tarnish. Find them.

hints: The Tarnish wears one face at a time. Its eyes burn; look for the light that is wrong.

completeLines.speaker: the_tarnish
completeLines.text: Your friend hums when he's frightened. We like the tune.

steps.title: The First Face
steps.description: It took Jory in the middle of Bell Square. Light brought him back. I didn't know it could.

lines.speaker: wren_hale
lines.text: Hold on, Jory. This is going to sting.

objectives.text: Burn the Tarnish out of Jory
hints: Any spell that hits a tarnished person burns it out of them. Light is the only thing it hates.

completeLines.speaker: jory_pell
completeLines.text: Ren? It was in my mouth. It was singing.

completeLines.speaker: wren_hale
completeLines.text: You're out. Breathe. It's gone from you.

completeLines.speaker: ilse_varrow
completeLines.text: So light does burn it out. Good. Now you know.

completeLines.speaker: wren_hale
completeLines.text: No. No, I was quick. I was quick.

lines.speaker: ilse_varrow
lines.text: It wants the pages. So we want them first.

lines.speaker: ilse_varrow
lines.text: One's on the Weigh-House roof, down in Pewterside.

lines.speaker: wren_hale
lines.text: Then I need a Pewterside shard.

lines.speaker: ilse_varrow
lines.text: Drifters bring them through. Ask under the Lantern Gate.

hints: Drifters bring shards through. Ask under the Lantern Gate.
The tarnished carry shards of their own side.

completeLines.speaker: wren_hale
completeLines.text: Grey glass. Pewterside, then.

steps.title: Through the Glass
steps.description: One page in each side. The first is in Pewterside. I'm going down through the glass.

hints: Hold Z (keyboard) or R3 (gamepad) to sink a side. A jump costs a shard of the side you go to and most of your mana.

steps.title: Dull as Ever
steps.description: Pewterside's grey as a spoon and twice as stubborn. The first page was on the Weigh-House roof, under eleven years of pigeons.

lines.speaker: ivy_harker
lines.text: For the record, the roof's been glowing. Is that yours? Lawfully?

lines.speaker: wren_hale
lines.text: It will be. Which way up?

lines.speaker: winnie_cobb
lines.text: Round the back, love, the stair by the drainpipe. Mind the third step.

lines.speaker: horace_pratt
lines.text: Nobody's been up there in eleven years. Mark my words, it'll be the death of you.

hints: Round the back of the Weigh-House, the stair by the drainpipe.
Hold X (keyboard) or Y (gamepad) to rise a side. The Gilt shard was waiting by the page.

steps.title: Hold the Line
steps.description: We held the Lantern Gate. Three people walked away with their own eyes. Maud didn't say thank you, which means she meant it.

objectives.text: Hold the Lantern Gate: burn the Tarnish out of 3 people ({count}/3)
hints: Stay by the Lantern Gate. Every tarnished you hit with a spell walks away with their own eyes.

progressLines.speaker: nell_bramley
progressLines.text: It came out of them! Sergeant, it came right out!

progressLines.speaker: hollis_greave
progressLines.text: Course you can do that. Course you can. Keep going.

completeLines.speaker: maud_kettering
completeLines.text: Silverer. You picked a busy night to come home. Hold here with us.

steps.title: The Key Where Light Won't Go Out
steps.description: Maud hid the tower key under a lamp that never goes out. She's been guarding it from her own captain's face.

lines.speaker: maud_kettering
lines.text: You want the Gilt Tower. I sealed it. I hid the key.

lines.speaker: maud_kettering
lines.text: A tarnished came for it wearing my captain's face. I trust nobody's face now.

lines.speaker: wren_hale
lines.text: Then trust what I just did.

lines.speaker: maud_kettering
lines.text: Noted. It's where the light never goes out. Go and look.

hints: Where the light never goes out: look under the lamps.

completeLines.speaker: wren_hale
completeLines.text: Brass and warm. Maud, you sentimental thing.

steps.title: The Gilt Tower
steps.description: The second page was in the Gilt Tower, where it's always been. The Tarnish says I'm building it a door.

lines.speaker: wren_hale
lines.text: Second leaf. It's warm, like it's been waiting.

objectives.text: Take the page inside the tower

lines.speaker: ilse_varrow
lines.text: The last leaf is above you, boy. Same tower, colder light.

lines.speaker: ilse_varrow
lines.text: Your mother went that way. Come back from it.

lines.speaker: wren_hale
lines.text: That's the plan. It's always been the plan.

objectives.text: Step up into Frostside from inside the tower
hints: The Frost Tower is sealed on every side. Stand inside the Gilt Tower and rise.

completeLines.speaker: wren_hale
completeLines.text: Cracks everywhere. It's been clawing at these walls.

completeLines.speaker: the_tarnish
completeLines.text: She stood just there, your mother. Right where you are.

steps.title: The Cracked Crown
steps.description: Third leaf, in the cracked tower. The mirror is whole. Now it burns.

objectives.text: Climb to the top of the Frost Tower
hints: The Tarnish waits at the top of the Frost Tower.

steps.title: Let the Light Through
steps.description: It's gone. I looked into the whole mirror, and the only face in it was mine.

objectives.text: Burn out the Tarnish with the Final Spell (F / X)
hints: Ordinary spells barely mark it. Press F (X / Square on a gamepad) for the Final Spell, and keep moving between casts.

quests.title: Unsigned
quests.summary: Fifty years ago a proud apprentice walked out on her master tailor. Ever since, bolts of wool have been turning up on his doorstep with no name.

offer.speaker: barnaby_thrale
offer.text: Wool on the doorstep again, Silverer. Good wool. No name. Now then, who?

after.speaker: odette_vane
after.text: Silverer. I'm sewing with the old man on Thursdays. Don't.

steps.title: Good Wool, No Name
steps.description: Somebody leaves Barnaby wool and won't sign it. Odette Vane on the Archive steps would know a hem.

objectives.text: Ask Odette Vane about the wool

completeLines.speaker: odette_vane
completeLines.text: Wool? Darling, I don't give wool away. Take this one to him. From a customer.

steps.title: From a Customer
steps.description: Odette gave me a bolt of wool "from a customer". It has a gold selvedge.

completeLines.speaker: barnaby_thrale
completeLines.text: From a customer. With a gold selvedge. Only one hand hems like that.

completeLines.speaker: barnaby_thrale
completeLines.text: Give her these. My first shears. She always wanted them. Tell her... tell her the seam held.

steps.title: The Seam Held
steps.description: Barnaby's first shears, for Odette. He says the seam held.

completeLines.speaker: odette_vane
completeLines.text: His shears. The old... Barnaby. He remembered the seam.

completeLines.speaker: odette_vane
completeLines.text: Go away, darling. Nobody sees me like this. Thank you. Go.

quests.title: The Lamps on Bell Lane
quests.summary: A lamplighter promised his dying father that Bell Lane would never go dark. Three lamps won't take, and the Tarnish is waiting in the gaps.

offer.speaker: corin_ashby
offer.text: Three lamps on Bell Lane won't take. I've trimmed them. I've prayed over them.

offer.speaker: corin_ashby
offer.text: You carry fire in your hands, Silverer. Would you lend it to them?

after.speaker: corin_ashby
after.text: Not one flicker all night, Silverer. Not one.

steps.title: Failing Lamps
steps.description: Three lamps on Bell Lane are failing. Fire should wake them.

hints: Cast a fire spell at the lamp, or stand under it and cast.

completeLines.speaker: wren_hale
completeLines.text: There. Burn, you stubborn thing.

steps.title: Watered Oil
steps.description: The lamps are lit, but Corin has been watering the oil.

completeLines.speaker: corin_ashby
completeLines.text: They'll fail again. I've been watering the oil. Father would weep.

steps.title: Real Oil
steps.description: Dov on Lantern Row has oil to spare, if anyone asks.

completeLines.speaker: dov_merriman
completeLines.text: Oil for Corin? By the furnace, why didn't the fool ask? Take the barrel.

steps.title: Light Holds
steps.description: Bell Lane will hold till dawn.

completeLines.speaker: corin_ashby
completeLines.text: Real oil. Bell Lane will hold till dawn. Light holds. It holds.

quests.title: The Glazier's Eyeglass
quests.summary: A scholar needs a relic to read the mirror's riddle. Its keeper wants nothing for it except someone to listen to her story to the end.

offer.speaker: tobias_quell
offer.text: The Glazier ground a lens to read silvered script. Which is to say, the pages.

offer.speaker: tobias_quell
offer.text: A family in Pewterside kept it. Pollard. Find it, and I'll read what the pages say.

after.speaker: ada_pollard
after.text: There's my good listener. Arthur, it's the Silverer. Sit, sit.

steps.title: The Pollards
steps.description: The Pollards of Pewterside kept the Glazier's eyeglass. Ada Pollard sits on the Fish Steps.

objectives.text: Find Ada Pollard on the Fish Steps in Pewterside

completeLines.speaker: ada_pollard
completeLines.text: The eyeglass? Oh, dearie. Sit down. It's a long story, isn't it, Arthur?

steps.title: A Long Story
steps.description: Nobody listens to Ada to the end. I did.

lines.speaker: ada_pollard
lines.text: My granny's granny swept the Glazier's floor. Every morning, glass dust.

lines.speaker: ada_pollard
lines.text: The night of the cut, the Glazier put this in her apron and said, keep it from the dark.

lines.speaker: ada_pollard
lines.text: Nine of us have kept it. In a sugar tin, mostly. Arthur thought it was a button.

completeLines.speaker: ada_pollard
completeLines.text: You listened to the end. Nobody does. Here. Take it, dearie.

hints: Stay close to Ada while she talks. Walk away and she waits for you.

steps.title: Into It, Not At It
steps.description: The last page asks the Silverer to look into the whole mirror.

objectives.text: Bring the eyeglass to Professor Quell

completeLines.speaker: tobias_quell
completeLines.text: Remarkable. With this, the script reads plain. Each page has a line, and the last one...

completeLines.speaker: tobias_quell
completeLines.text: ...says a Silverer must look into the whole mirror. Into it, not at it. I don't know what that costs.

completeLines.speaker: wren_hale
completeLines.text: Nine years of not looking. Seems about due.

quests.title: Letters Through the Glass
quests.summary: A young guard has written to the mother she lost through a rift fourteen years ago. The mother still rides the tram with an empty seat beside her.

offer.speaker: nell_bramley
offer.text: Sorry, I mean, this is nothing. It's a letter. To Pewterside.

offer.speaker: nell_bramley
offer.text: Coal Lane. Edie Bramley. She'd be old now. If she's... if.

accept.speaker: wren_hale
accept.text: I'll find her. What do I tell her?

after.speaker: nell_bramley
after.text: Next stop, Coal Lane. Mum used to say that. Funny.

steps.title: Coal Lane
steps.description: Nell's letter is for Edie Bramley, at the Coal Lane tram stop in Pewterside.

objectives.text: Find Edie Bramley at the Coal Lane tram stop in Pewterside

completeLines.speaker: edie_bramley
completeLines.text: That's her hand. That's her writing. Nine years old, she was.

completeLines.speaker: edie_bramley
completeLines.text: Give her this. The stub from that day. And this glass came through when she went. Take it.

steps.title: Fourteen Years
steps.description: Edie kept the ticket from the day Nell went through. Fourteen years.

completeLines.speaker: nell_bramley
completeLines.text: She kept the ticket. Fourteen years. Steady, Nell. Steady.
